opening.argument: The video presents a documented Defence Investiture Ceremony in which President Kovind awarded the Shaurya Chakra to Paratrooper Manchu. Its account identifies the ceremony as having taken place at Rashtrapati Bhavan on April 23, 2018, and explains that the recipient displayed courage and presence of mind under heavy fire while saving fellow squad members. The visible ceremonial setting supports this account: a soldier faces a suited official with ceremonial guards nearby. These are ordinary news and human-interest elements centered on a public award and reported military service, with no commercial or financial offer established.

citations.quote: President Kovind presents Shaurya Chakra to Paratrooper Manchu
presented Gallantry Awards and Distinguished Service Decorations at the Defence Investiture Ceremony held at Rashtrapati Bhavan on April 23, 2018.
He displayed raw courage, presence of mind under heavy fire, initiative and determination of very high order and saved lives of his fellow squad members.
